usage: Usually used for the soft, colorful parts of a flower around the center.
Common in everyday plant talk and simple descriptions of flowers; very natural with words like 花、玫瑰、散落、脫落.
Can be used for one petal or many petals depending on context; the word itself does not change form in Cantonese.
Learners can use it when identifying plant parts, describing flower shapes, or talking about petals on the ground.
